doc.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022

title: Meaning of 'baked into the track'
summary: Gluck explains that baked-in reverb means it was recorded with the vocal.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Which means that when they recorded it the reverb was on. When you say baked into the track.
Yeah that means it’s recorded along with let’s say the vocal and so forth.
